name: insulin like growth factor 1

function.text: IGF1 encodes insulin-like growth factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include hormone activity and growth factor activity. It participates in signal transduction and Ras protein signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from G2P. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: IGF1 encodes insulin-like growth factor 1. Based in part on similarity, the insulin-like growth factors, isolated from plasma, are structurally and functionally related to insulin but have a much higher growth-promoting activity. It stimulates glucose transport in bone-derived osteoblastic (PyMS) cells and is effective at much lower concentrations than insulin, not only regarding glycogen and DNA synthesis but also with regard to enhancing glucose uptake. May play a role in synapse maturation.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with growth delay due to insulin-like growth factor type 1 deficiency (autosomal recessive).
